pages.name: events-list
pages.extract: () => ({headers: [...document.querySelectorAll('table thead th')].map(t=>t.innerText.trim()), rows: [...document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr')].map(r=>[...r.querySelectorAll('td')].map(c=>c.innerText.trim()).join(' | ')), searchBox: !!document.querySelector('input[type=search], input[placeholder*=earch]'), selects: [...document.querySelectorAll('select')].map(e=>({name: e.name||e.id||e.getAttribute('aria-label'), options: [...e.options].map(o=>o.value+'='+o.text)})), combos: [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=combobox]')].map(e=>(e.getAttribute('aria-label')||e.id||e.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,40)), paginationText: document.body.innerText.match(/Page [^\n]*/)?.[0]})

pages.name: event-new-form

[...e.selectedOptions].map(o=>o.text).join(',') : e.value])), combos: [...document.querySelectorAll('form [role=combobox]')].map(e=>(e.getAttribute('aria-label')||e.id||'')+'='+e.innerText.trim().slice(0,60))})
